sentences.zh: 你知道，这些会是医院、宗教建筑或是政府建筑。

sentences.en: And in those buildings, we also quantified how fractal the buildings were, how much curved edge structure the buildings had.
sentences.zh: 在这些建筑中，我们还量化了它们的的分形程度，以及它们有多少曲线边缘结构。

sentences.en: And basically what we found was that the buildings had more curved edge structure, had more fractalness.
sentences.zh: 基本上我们发现的是，曲线边缘结构更多、分形程度更高的建筑，

sentences.en: People said they liked the buildings more and that they actually thought that the buildings were more natural than buildings that were sort of more rectilinear,
sentences.zh: 人们表示他们更喜欢，并且他们实际上认为这些建筑比那些更偏向直线条的建筑更自然，

sentences.en: that had just straight lines.
sentences.zh: 也就是只有直线的建筑。

sentences.en: And the same was also true of building interiors.
sentences.zh: 建筑内部也是如此。

sentences.en: So just like not all nature is created equal, not all of the built environment is created equal.
sentences.zh: 因此，就像并非所有的自然都是生而平等的一样，并非所有的建造环境也是生而平等的。

sentences.en: And it does have me thinking or wondering whether even without actually using any real nature, if we designed the built environment with a lot of these natural patterns,
sentences.zh: 这确实让我思考或好奇，即使不使用任何真正的自然，如果我们用许多这些自然模式来设计建造环境，

sentences.en: could that yield some of these cognitive benefits?
sentences.zh: 这能带来一些这样的认知益处吗？

sentences.en: And the architect Christopher Alexander, you know, wrote many books about this, encouraging architects to try to mimic patterns of nature in their architecture,
sentences.zh: 建筑师克里斯托弗·亚历山大写了许多关于这方面的书，鼓励建筑师尝试在建筑中模仿自然的模式，

sentences.en: that that would lead to more vibrant buildings that would make people feel more connected to the environment, but might also induce some different psychological benefits.
sentences.zh: 认为这会带来更有活力的建筑，让人们感到与环境有更紧密的联系，但也可能会引发一些不同的心理益处。

sentences.en: And I do remember one time, my colleague Candace Vogler, who's a philosopher,
sentences.zh: 我还记得有一次，我的同事坎德斯·沃格勒，她是一位哲学家，

sentences.en: she joked with me one time that the Durham Chapel at Duke is so beautiful that it does the praying for you.
sentences.zh: 她曾跟我开玩笑说，杜克大学的达勒姆教堂太美了，它甚至能替你祈祷。

sentences.en: And, you know, I kind of wonder, you know, is the architecture, you know, at the University of Chicago, you know, so grand, does it do the studying, you know, for you?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我有点好奇，芝加哥大学的建筑，你知道，是如此宏伟，它能替你学习吗？

sentences.en: And, you know, and I remember being a student at the University of Michigan,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我记得自己曾是密歇根大学的学生，

sentences.en: and I would often try to study in the law library that had this really grand and intricate reading room versus studying in the undergraduate library that was called the ugly.
sentences.zh: 我经常试图在那个拥有极其宏伟且错综复杂的阅览室的法学院图书馆学习，而不是在那个被称为丑陋的本科生图书馆学习。

sentences.en: Because the law library just, it just felt so much better to be in there with all of that beautiful architecture.
sentences.zh: 因为在法学院图书馆里，身处所有那些美丽的建筑之中，感觉实在是太好了。

sentences.zh: 我是 Hidden Brain 的执行主编。

sentences.en: Before we go today, we wanted to say thank you to Loom by Atlassian for sponsoring the Hidden Brain 2025 Perceptions Tour.
sentences.zh: 在我们今天离开之前，我们要感谢 Atlassian 的 Loom 赞助 Hidden Brain 2025 年“认知之旅”。

sentences.en: With Loom, teams move work forward faster, replacing endless meetings and slow approvals with quick, clear video messages.
sentences.zh: 通过 Loom，团队能够更快地推动工作进展，用快速、清晰的视频消息取代无休止的会议和缓慢的审批。

sentences.en: Today, we'll hear from Dr. Molly Sands, head of the Teamwork Lab at Atlassian, about how Loom is transforming the way teams work.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将听到 Atlassian 团队协作实验室负责人莫莉·桑兹博士关于 Loom 如何改变团队工作方式的分享。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Molly Sands, and I lead the Teamwork Lab at Atlassian, which is our future of work research and innovation group.
sentences.zh: 我是莫莉·桑兹博士，我领导 Atlassian 的团队协作实验室，这是我们的未来工作研究与创新小组。

sentences.en: If I could wave the magic wand and change something about teamwork, I would stop teams from using meetings for every single thing.
sentences.zh: 如果我能挥动魔杖改变团队合作的一点，我会阻止团队把每件事都用来开会。

sentences.en: I wish teams would embrace asynchronous communication, so sharing updates or feedback in ways that don't require everyone to drop what they're doing at the same time.
sentences.zh: 我希望团队能够拥抱异步沟通，即以不需要每个人同时放下手头工作的方式分享更新或反馈。

sentences.en: Loom is a video messaging platform that lets you quickly record and share updates, walkthroughs, or feedback without scheduling another meeting.
sentences.zh: Loom 是一个视频消息平台，可让你快速录制和分享更新、演练或反馈，而无需安排另一场会议。

sentences.en: The magic of Loom is that it feels really personal, like someone tapping you on the shoulder, but it's actually asynchronous.
sentences.zh: Loom 的神奇之处在于它感觉非常私人，就像有人在拍你的肩膀，但实际上它是异步的。

sentences.en: Loom makes it very easy for teams to share and get the information they need in less time.
sentences.zh: Loom 让团队能够以更少的时间轻松分享并获取所需的信息。

sentences.en: And the more that teams use Loom to communicate and to capture conversations, the smarter their AI-enabled knowledge bases get.
sentences.zh: 团队使用 Loom 进行沟通和捕捉对话的次数越多，他们由人工智能赋能的知识库就会变得越聪明。

sentences.en: It lets people design their day around their energy and around their priorities instead of being trapped by their meeting schedule.
sentences.zh: 它让人们能够根据自己的精力和优先级来设计自己的一天，而不是被会议日程所束缚。

sentences.en: Loom is AI-powered video communication that moves teams forward.
sentences.zh: Loom 是由人工智能驱动的视频沟通工具，能够推动团队前进。

sentences.en: Whether you're sharing feedback, obtaining approvals, or setting context, Loom makes it easy for teams to share and collaborate on work.
sentences.zh: 无论你是分享反馈、获取审批还是设定背景，Loom 都能让团队轻松共享工作并开展协作。

sentences.en: Save time and stay focused on what matters without another meeting.
sentences.zh: 节省时间，专注于重要的事情，无需再开会。

sentences.en: Try Loom today at loom.com.
sentences.zh: 今天就去 loom.com 试用 Loom 吧。
